name: virtual degree of freedom method
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 文中构造轮轨接触耦合矩阵的自由度处理方法。
usage_overview: 在轮轨接触耦合矩阵构造中，用于处理接口与真实自由度之间的关系：先借助少量接口自由度组装耦合矩阵，再映射到真实自由度并消元。

complete_examples.text: In the terms of wheel-rail relationship, a method based on virtual degree of freedom method is proposed, and the wheel-rail coupling matrices are formed in the global coordinate system to avoid the complicated coordinate transformation.
